sentence: A spinning wheel that picks one of a fixed set of food places at random, with the result chosen by the server so everyone sees the same winner.
use_when: a group cannot agree on where to eat and wants a random pick
someone asks to spin a wheel to choose between a few places
a quick tiebreak among a short, fixed list of options is needed
dont_use_when: people want to vote and see counts, which needs a poll
the options list must be edited or is not three places
a fair split of costs or tasks is needed instead of a single pick
